Title: A callable neutrality and rendering-symmetry check over a pipeline item, so VERIFIED can be reached
What this is: The verification pipeline's VERIFIED stage requires a NEUTRALITY_AND_RENDERING_SYMMETRY check with a PASS result. Nothing callable exists under lib/ today: lib/control-plane/capability.ts carries assertNeutralityEnabled, a policy-flag invariant, not a check over a record. Until a check exists the record carries NOT_IMPLEMENTED and VERIFIED is refused for every item — the honest state, never a silent pass. The check must read the item's rendered form and refuse any ranking, recommendation, alignment score, or asymmetry between candidates in one contest.
Detail: Predicate for auto-resolution: a module under lib/ exports a function the pipeline's VERIFIED builder calls for NEUTRALITY_AND_RENDERING_SYMMETRY AND a promotion_pipeline record with stage VERIFIED exists in the control plane.

Title: Register the nightly window's backup wakeup task from an elevated shell
What this is: The window runs on the pilot runner's own clock at 04:00 America/New_York; the Scheduled Task WeThePeople Nightly Window is only a backup wakeup (it appends RUN_WINDOW_NOW when the runner is alive, or runs the window under the lease when it is dead). Registration needs an elevated PowerShell on this host, as the runner's task did. Run once, elevated, in the main checkout: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/pilot-task.ps1 -Action install-window. Without it a runner that is down across 04:00 still runs the missed window at its next start, by name, so nothing is lost — only the earliest possible wakeup.
Detail: Predicate for auto-resolution: Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'WeThePeople Nightly Window' returns a task with at least one Daily trigger.

Title: Which record classes open first at the activation gate
What this is: RULING 242: the nightly window promotes only APPROVED items of record classes the activation gate has opened. The open set is EMPTY and opening a class is the owner's decision. The candidates named as low-risk in lib/control-plane/promotion/activation-gate.ts are meeting-times, agendas, published-minutes and routine-filings; candidate-positions, campaign-finance, candidate-enrichment, ballot and votes stay closed until approved by name. This decision cannot take effect until READER, TRUTH and FRESHNESS are GREEN and INDEPENDENTLY_REPRODUCED, so it is not urgent; it is recorded now so the list exists when the gate can open.
Detail: NOT_MACHINE_VERIFIABLE. Decision card — WHAT IS NEEDED: name the first record classes to open (zero or more of meeting-times, agendas, published-minutes, routine-filings). OPTIONS: (a) open meeting-times and agendas first — meeting alerts move through the window; consequence: the first promoted reader truth is a meeting time or an agenda, the lowest-stakes class, verified on the served surface each night; (b) open published-minutes and routine-filings too — consequence: minutes and routine filings also promote nightly, more surface per window; (c) open none yet — consequence: the window stays in SHADOW after the gate is otherwise green, and every promotion remains a session's last mile. Any owner-approved class (campaign-finance, ballot, votes, candidate-positions, candidate-enrichment) needs its own decision by name. AGE: opened 2026-09-02.
